faq.a: Mikayil is associated with the Arabic form مِيكَائِيل, whose core sense is mikayil; michael (angel) (azerbaijani form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Mikayil?
faq.a: Mikayil is associated with Arabic. Mikayil is the Azerbaijani form of Arabic مِيكَائِيل (Mīkāʾīl), the Quranic name of the angel Michael.
Yes — the underlying form مِيكَائِيل is Arabic.
Mikayil can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Mikayil should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Mīkāʾīl is the Quranic Arabic name of the angel Michael and occurs in the Quran.

faq.q: What does Mikayil mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Mikayil is rendered میکائیل and carries the sense میکائیل، فرشتہ.

faq.q: What does Mikayil mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Mikayil is rendered میکائیل and carries the sense میکائیل، فرشته.
A romanized syllable approximation is mi-kayil. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Mikayil?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Mikayil, mikayil. Script forms are ميکائيل, مِيكَائِيل, میکائیل, मीकाईल.

faq.q: Is Mikayil a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
